motivation: R54 exhausted the pretraining data lever (best holdout candidate_max 0.06478 @ ep15, then a 25-epoch plateau wiggling 0.0648-0.0722 while train loss kept falling). Free diagnostics (r54 updates.jsonl): hinge component ~0 after ep2, gradient norms smooth and unclipped after ep3, so the gap is generalization-side, not optimization noise. Two optimizer-side levers have never been pulled on this chain: (1) Polyak weight EMA as an evaluation/checkpoint track, targeting the +-0.004 epoch-to-epoch holdout wiggle; (2) SOAP second-order preconditioning, which in this same project's A+1 chain improved holdout 0.0504 -> 0.0411 and cleared family-specific artifacts (a generalization effect, not merely faster training loss).

A_adamw_ema.single_variable_claim: training trajectory is byte-identical in expectation to R54 v2 (same optimizer, lr, schedule, seed, data, sampling); the ONLY addition is a passive EMA evaluation/checkpoint track. The raw shadow track doubles as an R54 replication control.

B_soap_ema.single_variable_claim: relative to arm A the only change is AdamW -> SOAP (betas (0.95,0.95), precondition_frequency 10, precondition_1d true, lr/weight_decay/cosine schedule unchanged from CLI). B-raw vs A-raw isolates the SOAP effect; B-ema vs B-raw isolates EMA on the SOAP trajectory.
B_soap_ema.soap_provenance: pytorch_optimizer 3.10.1; hyperparameters copied from build_capacity_optimizer in diagnose_capacity_ladder_overfit.py (A+1 chain, validated)

ema_mechanics: EMA updated after every optimizer step on all ranks; at each per-epoch evaluation rank 0 evaluates raw weights (shadow), swaps EMA weights in, evaluates again (primary track drives best-selection and best.pt), and the raw weights are restored inside DistributedSampler.set_epoch before any forward of the next epoch, so training dynamics are provably untouched.

judgement_frozen.primary_metric: best-over-epochs holdout candidate_max, reported per track (A-raw, A-ema, B-raw, B-ema)
judgement_frozen.replication_control: A-raw best candidate_max must land within 0.005 of R54 v2 (0.06478); a larger deviation voids the comparison and is reported as a reproducibility finding
judgement_frozen.noise_margin: R54 plateau wiggle is ~+-0.004; improvements <= 0.002 are noise-level
judgement_frozen.signal_gate: any of A-ema / B-raw / B-ema achieves best candidate_max < 0.06278 (= 0.06478 - 0.002): optimizer lever confirmed, that checkpoint becomes chain-best deliverable and the frozen R55 selective evaluation is run on it
judgement_frozen.failure_signal: no track < 0.06278: the optimizer/EMA lever is falsified at noise level for this chain; deliverable remains R54 best.pt + R55 conformal abstention and the remaining route is parent-quality (marmousi LWC-84 coarse solve), per r54_scratch_fullpool_decision_report_20260829.md
judgement_frozen.no_post_hoc_extension: 40 epochs, no budget extension without a new preregistration

budget.checkpoint_policy: best.pt only per arm, overwrite in place (SOAP optimizer state makes B best.pt ~100-200MB, acceptable)
